evals.prompt: Generate a complete Unity C# script for the TurnManager system in our roguelike dungeon crawler. It needs to: manage a turn queue of entities (player + enemies), expose SubmitPlayerAction() that triggers turn resolution, iterate through all registered enemies after the player acts (in speed order), expose events OnTurnResolutionStart and OnTurnResolutionEnd, and implement the IActable interface registration/unregistration. The game is 2D, URP, new Input System, Unity 2022 LTS.
evals.expected_output: A complete, compilable C# script file for TurnManager.cs following Unity best practices: proper namespace, SerializeField usage, XML doc comments on public API, events, the IActable interface definition, RequireComponent if needed, cached references, and a closing note with file path and Inspector setup instructions.
expectations: Output includes a complete C# script file saved to the outputs folder
Script defines or references an IActable interface with at least a TakeAction method
TurnManager has RegisterEntity and UnregisterEntity public methods
TurnManager has OnTurnResolutionStart and OnTurnResolutionEnd events
Script uses SerializeField (not public fields) for any inspector-exposed values
Script includes XML doc comments on public methods
Output ends with a note about file path, Inspector setup, and next steps
